components.name: Catalogue Navigation
components.description: Compact product navigation with language and GitHub access.

narrative.overview: The portal treats the community catalogue as Aidget's desktop workbench opened to the public. Cool app neutrals and a clear blue brand signal give the landing page a calm, productive presence, while real widget screenshots provide the evidence and the app's checkerboard stage provides a familiar product cue.
keyCharacteristics: Cool and spacious in the hero, restrained and utilitarian in the catalogue.
Real screenshots carry the visual proof.
Blue expresses the product identity and install actions.
Rounded geometry and raised media surfaces echo the desktop app.

rules.name: The Restrained Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue owns brand emphasis and installation, while green owns community attribution; these roles do not swap.

rules.name: The One Raised Object Rule
rules.body: The hero product stage receives the full display shadow; repeated cards use one shared, quieter card elevation.

dos: Do let real widget screenshots lead each catalogue entry.
Do keep brand, install, and verification colors in their fixed roles.
Do preserve readable secondary text through at least 4.5:1 contrast.
Do keep the hero product image placeholder visibly provisional until a real capture is supplied.
donts: Don't add display letter spacing tighter than -0.04em.
Don't turn the repeated catalogue into nested raised cards.
Don't introduce a second decorative visual world inside the catalogue.
Don't use English-only text inside imagery shared by both language pages.
